providers.findings: Contains genuine meteorological values (lat, lon, wind, pressure) transcribed from IBTrACS for 6 major storms. It is a small curated sample rather than the full ~50MB IBTrACS global or basin archive.

NASA GIBS WMTS endpoints are correctly formatted and live-tested. However, tiles are fetched directly by Leaflet in the user's browser. No NASA GIBS satellite raster is downloaded, preprocessed, or fed as an input tensor into any PyTorch model.
Adapter code structure is complete and correctly reports CREDENTIALS_REQUIRED. Does not bypass authentication or invent undocumented endpoints. No INSAT observations are downloaded or ingested.

CRITICAL FINDING: The 5 sample images (biparjoy, mocha, dana, amphan, depression) fed to Model A (detector) and Model B (classifier) were generated using NumPy trigonometric cosine spiral formulas and OpenCV Gaussian blurs. They are synthetic simulations, not genuine raw satellite captures from INSAT or NOAA.
